To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the heat transfer coefficient and pressure drop of spiral finned tube heat exchanger is almost constant over Reynolds number range from 1500 to above 6000 and the heat transfer coefficient increases by 5% when the spiral finned tube rows are increased from 4 to 5.

the heat transfer coefficient and friction factor of the spiral finned-tubes are strongly dependent on the Reynolds number, and the overall heat transfer coefficient increases with increasing the number of rows.

(1) the overall heat transfer coefficient is not significantly influenced by the number of fin rows; (2) the air-side heat transfer and friction factors increase as Reynolds number increases; and (3) the air-side Colburn factor is not influenced by the Reynolds number.
